spots.name: Marina Munch Food Truck Park
spots.venue: English Landing Marina, 509 S. Ponce de Leon Blvd, St. Augustine
spots.trucksText: Up to 5 trucks: a few regulars plus rotating guests
spots.desc: St. Augustine's only dedicated food truck park, on the marina. Pet and family friendly, with a small covered seating area.
spots.tips: Seating is limited at peak times. The lineup changes, so check their Facebook page if you're after a specific truck.

spots.name: Riverside Arts Market
spots.venue: Under the Fuller Warren Bridge, 715 Riverside Ave, Jacksonville
spots.trucksText: Food trucks and local food vendors
spots.desc: The big Saturday market by the river, with food trucks and vendors alongside art, produce and live music. Covered by the bridge, so it runs rain or shine.

spots.name: Food Truck Friday at Spring Park
spots.venue: Spring Park, 200 Spring St, Green Cove Springs
spots.trucksText: Lots of food trucks and vendors
spots.desc: Green Cove Springs' monthly food truck night on the riverfront park, with room for kids to run around and the spring-fed pool next door.

stops.title: Friendship Fountain Saturday Sounds
stops.desc: Free riverfront evening with local bands, food trucks and lawn games while the fountain lights up.

stops.title: Jax Parks Movie Night
